metadata.article_title: Punishment for abetment of certain offences.

article.title: Punishment for abetment of certain offences.
article.content: Whoever abets the commission of an offence under section 184, section 185 or section 186 shall be punishable with the punishment provided for the offence.
article.html:
188Punishment for abetment of certain offences.

Section 188 · Chapter XIII · page 104 of the Act

Whoever abets the commission of an offence under section 184, section 185 or section 186 shall be punishable with the punishment provided for the offence.
